text:
megan: @here Realtime Bridge v1.0 is now generally available for Hosted API. This adds low-latency streaming + tool-calling with single-request multi-step invocation patterns. Docs: https://redwood.com/docs/realtime-bridge

sam: huge congrats! Where can teams find migration guide from streaming/v2?

megan: migration guide: https://redwood.com/docs/realtime-bridge/migration - includes examples for chat, function/tool-calls, and structured output. We'll also publish SDK snippets in the next hour.

eli: Ops note: Hosted rollout is phased by region. Initial regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1. us-east-1 available with limited capacity for non-production traffic.

ops-bot: Deploy status: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% across the initial regions. Metric watch: p50 token latency <= 55ms, error-rate < 0.5% during canary. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall. :rocket:

alejandro: Perf tip: enable prefix cache + adaptive batching for high-throughput chat apps. Example inference config to try locally:
```
model: redwood-mosaic-realtime
endpoint: /v2/realtime
streaming: realtime_bridge
cache: prefix_kv
batching:
  mode: adaptive
  max_batch_size: 64
```

sam: Any deprecation for the older /v1/stream endpoint?

megan: yes — /v1/stream will be deprecated in 90 days. We will auto-redirect with a deprecation warning header for 60 days, then responses will be rejected. Please migrate to /v2/realtime.

devex-bot: Quick start snippet for Node/Python (also published in SDK docs):
```python
from redwood import RealtimeClient
c = RealtimeClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
with c.stream("/v2/realtime", model="mosaic-realtime") as s:
    s.send({"input": "Summarize the release notes"})
    for chunk in s.recv():
        print(chunk)
```

megan: If you're on Dedicated or Private, please ping your SE for a configuration bundle and rollout checklist. We'll also add a migration helper script to the repo. Post any breaking issues here or open a support ticket referencing `realtime-v1->v2-migration`.

eli: tagging @devex — can we run two office hours next week to walk teams through common migrations? :calendar:

alejandro: +1 for office hours. Note: billing change — realtime path will bill as per-stream + per-token; see https://redwood.com/pricing/realtime for details.

megan: thanks all — customer announcement scheduled for 14:00 PT. Follow-ups: migration Q&A doc, SDK patches for node/python, and a blog post with benchmarks next week.
